Target company: Apple (AAPL). Apple develops and sells personal computing devices including iPhone, Mac and iPad, with operating systems and digital services.

Focal announcement: Apple reports third quarter results.

Decision cutoff: 2024-08-01T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Apple reports third quarter results. Published date: 2024-08-01. URL: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2024/08/apple-reports-third-quarter-results.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today announced financial results for its fiscal 2024 third quarter ended June 29, 2024. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $85.8 billion, up 5 percent year over year, and quarterly earnings per diluted share of $1.40, up 11 percent year over year. “Today Apple is reporting a new June quarter revenue record of $85.8 billion, up 5 percent from a year ago,” said Tim Cook, Apple’s CEO. “During the quarter, our record business performance generated EPS growth of 11 percent and nearly $29 billion in operating cash flow, allowing us to return over $32 billion to shareholders,” said Luca Maestri, Apple’s CFO. Apple’s board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.25 per share of the Company’s common stock.
